text:
Alex H: Quick release-lane check — cut window opens in ~3h. Quick status: staging canary passed 2/3 services, but we're still holding on gpu-pool PRs. Please post any urgent backports or blockers. :eyes:
Priya S: Staging test-suite is red on the raft integration test. Investigating now, looks like a timing flake in leader election. Failing job: https://ci.redwood/teams/eng-releases/9876
Jamal K: FYI infra: dedicated-gpu pool is at 94% reserved due to a long-running perf experiment. Can't scale that pool for canary without squeezing other jobs. I'll free up 1 node in ~45m. :man_shrugging:
Emily R: Merged hotfix for token cache key in master (PR #4123). Can we trigger a new canary after Jamal frees the node? I added the rollout flag: --canary=true
Dmitri V: Noted. Also saw a spike in 95th latency around 18:20 UTC, might be related to recent kernel patch. Watching APM traces. If latency > 200ms for 3 consecutive minutes, we should rollback the canary.
release-bot: Canary deployment started: release/v2026.03.16 -> us-east-1/us-west-2. status=IN_PROGRESS
Priya S: Current blocker: raft-test flake and a failing e2e that only reproduces on pooled infra. Repro steps I used:
```
pytest tests/integration/test_raft.py::test_leader_election -k 'timing' -q
# runs consistently locally with --maxfail=1 --durations=10
```
Alex H: Thanks Priya. Can you post a short blameless triage with logs into the incident channel if you need attention after 30m? We can't delay cut more than 2h without pushing the whole train.
Jamal K: Node reclaimed, freed 1 x a100. Triggering canary now.
release-bot: Canary update: us-east-1 -> SUCCESS, us-west-2 -> FAILED (service=runtime-gpu, error=OOM while allocating KV cache). Rolling back us-west-2.
Emily R: Ack. Re-triggered a reduced-memory canary with quantized model variant (q4_0). Command: `rd-deploy --variant=q4_0 --canary`
Dmitri V: I'm watching traces. If q4_0 shows normal latencies and no OOM, we can promote. If we still see >200ms tail, we should abort.
Priya S: If we promote q4_0, I'll snapshot the raft test run and run a longer integration sweep against that variant before cut.
Alex H: Plan for next 90m: Jamal finishes infra stabilization, Emily verifies q4_0 canary health, Priya runs raft integration sweep, Dmitri monitors latency. If all green, proceed with cut; if not, we delay cut by +2h and notify PMs. Ping here with status updates. :shipit:
